A backup is the camera\'s own settings file. It holds every setting, including your C1–C7 custom settings with your film-simulation recipes. Restoring puts all of them back, onto the same camera model.
This replaces ALL the camera\'s settings, including C1–C7, with the ones in this backup. Keep the camera on and nearby until it finishes.\n\nTip: back up the current settings first.
